system.description:
Limitations: Can't be used on saferoom doors or living things.

You create a temporary cylindrical hole in a surface or material within range, to a depth of 1 inch per Spell Rank and a diameter of 2ft. Anything that can fit in the hole can pass through it if the hole is deep enough to penetrate to the other side of the surface.

Note: this terrain-manipulation effect has no structural support in this system - track manually.

upgrades.description: You can reduce the diameter of the hole to a smaller size when cast.
You can widen the hole's diameter by 1 inch for every inch of depth you sacrifice when cast.
The caster may end the spell with a thought (like an Interrupt, but it doesn't cost an Action). Anything in the hole at that time is destroyed.

system.duration: Until the end of the combat or 5 minutes.
